item.title: Why American investors love European defense startups
item.description: As European defense spending takes off, just about half of the funding in Europe's defense tech industry is coming from American investors this year. One reason why: European investment firms have restrictions on how they can invest.

item.title: Economist Betsey Stevenson breaks down the gender gap in recent hiring reports
item.description: The U.S. economy added fewer jobs than expected last month and unemployment ticked up to 4.2%. NPR's Scott Simon talks to Betsey Stevenson, an economist at the University of Michigan.

item.title: The U.S. added only 29,000 jobs in September as job market lacks spark
item.description: U.S. employers added 29,000 jobs in September as the unemployment rate inched up to 4.2%. Job gains for July and August were revised down by a total of 60,000 jobs, extending a lackluster run for the job market.

item.title: Why is diesel more expensive than regular gas?
item.description: Diesel hasn't always been more expensive than other gasoline. Then in 2004, a switch happened due to air quality standards, demand, and taxes. In this week's Indicator newsletter, we dig into diesel prices, what kind of fun people are buying, and other forms of making your tax bill smaller.

item.title: Some of the super wealthy are plowing money into a tax loophole to slash taxes to 0
